extDescription.message: Ask Sub Rosa about the page you are reading. Works with the Sub Rosa app on your computer.

menuAskSelection.description: Context menu item on selected text

pairBody.message: In Sub Rosa on this computer, open Settings, then Browser extension, and choose Connect a browser. Type the code it shows.

pairCodeLabel.description: Label of the pairing code field

paired.message: This browser is connected to Sub Rosa.

summarizePrompt.description: The question sent when Summarize is pressed

includePage.description: Checkbox: send the page text with the question

continuesInApp.message: This chat is also in Sub Rosa, in your chats.

errorAppNotRunning.message: Sub Rosa is not open on this computer. Open it, then try again.

errorHostNotFound.message: This browser is not set up for Sub Rosa yet. In Sub Rosa, open Settings, then Browser extension, and choose Connect a browser.

errorNotPaired.message: This browser is not connected to Sub Rosa any more. Type a new code to connect it again.

errorPairingNotStarted.message: Sub Rosa is not showing a code. In Settings, Browser extension, choose Connect a browser first.

errorPairingWrong.message: That code is not the one Sub Rosa shows. Check it and try again.

errorPairingExpired.message: That code expired. Show a new one in Sub Rosa.

errorPairingExhausted.message: Too many wrong codes. Show a new one in Sub Rosa.

errorNotAPage.message: Sub Rosa can only read web pages.

errorNoAccess.message: Click the Sub Rosa button in the toolbar to let it read this page.

errorUpdateApp.message: Update Sub Rosa to use this version of the extension.

errorBusy.message: This chat is still answering. Wait for it, then ask again.
